title: Heist System for PvP
description: This datapack creates a "heist" where players get points, if they are near it
body:
This datapack introduces a dynamic Heist system to your Minecraft server. A heist is a designated point where players earn points simply by staying within its area. It’s perfect for creating competitive events, PvP battles, or team-based challenges, adding an exciting objective to fight over.

To set up a heist, an operator can run the following command: 
                                                              
/execute positioned [INSERT THE COORDINATES WHERE THE HEIST WILL TAKE PLACE] run function heists:host_heist

Once activated, the heist becomes a hotspot for competition, encouraging players to strategize, defend, and dominate the location to secure victory.
